finalText:
**Redis died and took prod with it.** One cause, 17 minutes to death.

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`, cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, store overloaded |
| 02:15:26 → 02:31:26 | 13 reconnect attempts, all refused |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes the 500 cap at 562 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` hits `JavaScript heap out of memory`, exits 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back. Cache hit ratio was 0.98 right before, so every read went to the store. No recovery in the log. Next: check why Redis refused connections.
